# pffft / pffft_real_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `pffft_real_fuzzer` ([source](source/pffft_fuzzer.cc), unmodified) over pffft (bitbucket.org/jpommier/pffft at 0aec0327).

Forward pffft_transform, pffft_zconvolve_accumulate(out,out,out) and backward pffft_transform_ordered are run on the fuzzed floats; the outputs are never compared to the input (no inverse/round-trip check, no Parseval check, no comparison against fftpack).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against pffft at commit 0aec0327.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- assert(number_of_bytes <= size) where number_of_bytes = (size / kSizeOfOneSample) * kSizeOfOneSample: true by integer division for every size, so it checks nothing about pffft (trivially true) ([lines 71-72](source/pffft_fuzzer.cc#L71-L72)): assert(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch pffft` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `pffft_real_fuzzer.plain` | 65,528 | `20543263d1b3425a5e51a8d41406b08dd88aaca64c460252e9bd2cc0923430ea` |
| ubsan | `pffft_real_fuzzer.ubsan` | 86,944 | `7e6c45b847427610f832d1e85afb3e08ee89bc73d6799784d0ca587c30c62b5a` |
| asan | `pffft_real_fuzzer.asan` | 782,360 | `747304106c9110c5b1bf2d0c90090dd2bfd2bfd046ecc58a5db952e6bf786b69` |
| asan-ubsan | `pffft_real_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 800,536 | `703b481303635e51c45d637469cb7f2dd995f4e83df4acb74702f34245b2a352` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
